query.sql: WITH suspicious AS (SELECT eventID, eventTime, sourceIPAddress, userAgent, eventName, eventSource, awsRegion, userIdentityarn, userIdentityuserName, errorCode, requestID FROM cloudtrail WHERE userAgent ILIKE '%command/%') SELECT eventID, eventTime, sourceIPAddress, userAgent, eventName, eventSource, awsRegion, userIdentityarn, userIdentityuserName, errorCode, requestID FROM suspicious ORDER BY CAST(eventTime AS TIMESTAMP) DESC

explanation.interpretation: The hypothesis asks for CloudTrail events where the userAgent string contains the suspicious marker 'command/' (any text following it), indicating potentially malicious or scripted clients.
explanation.reasoning: I filter the cloudtrail table on userAgent using a LIKE/ILIKE pattern because 'command/*' is not one of the listed discrete values. I return the identifying and contextual columns an analyst needs to investigate: event time, source IP, user agent, API action, service, region, actor ARN/username, error code, and request/ event IDs.
assumptions: Empty userAgent values are NULL and will not match the pattern.
The pattern 'command/*' means any user agent containing the literal substring 'command/'; case differences are tolerated with ILIKE.
